scheme_name: Personal Accident Relief for Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: The applicant must be a registered member of the Welfare Board for the Differently‑Abled
The applicant must have died or become differently‑abled as a result of an accident
The disability must be one of the specified types: loss of both legs, both hands, one hand, one leg, loss of sight in one eye or both eyes
benefits_summary: Provides financial relief up to ₹1,00,000 to the legal heir in case of death, and up to ₹1,00,000 or ₹50,000 for specified disabilities, with a minimum of ₹25,000 for other total disablements.
application_link: Step 1: Visit the District Differently Abled Welfare Office during office hours and request a hard copy of the prescribed application form. Step 2: Fill in all mandatory fields and attach copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest if required). Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed form along with the documents to the District Differently Abled Welfare Officer. Step 4: Request a receipt or acknowledgment containing the date, time of submission, and a unique identification number (if applicable).
